text: Hey Ananta. What happened with the market yesterday? What did we do and what did you see and what did you find?
answer: Sir, yesterday (Monday 2 Nov, now closed) the Nifty rose 1.7% to 23,440, opening up and climbing all day, while Bank Nifty gained 0.6% to 55,002. We took two paper option trades, one Bank Nifty and one Nifty call, each held to the next open, and passed on the other three decision points. Your stocks were up about Rs 2,172 (+2.2%), led by JIOFIN (+4.3%) and TATAPOWER (+3.1%), with KARURVYSYA the one real loser (-3.3%). The managed book's first plan (10 cuts, 3 buys) was due to fill at the open, but the official fill numbers only land with tonight's run, so I can't say yet how it did.
